modules.module_title: Adhere to Health and Hygiene Protocols

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and personal hygiene- related protocols as per regulatory guidelines
sanitize your hands before entering in Testing lab area and ensure the adherence of same by subordinates
report any allergy, sickness or any other environment-related breach before or after entering the work premises to the designated person
take preventive actions on the report of any allergy, sickness or any other environment related breach by subordinates
wear lab equipments like close-toed shoes, coat, etc., all the time while working in Testing lab area and ensure adherence of the same by every person visiting/ working in the Testing facility
Ensure proper disposal of used accessories

modules.module_title: Adhere to Safety and Security Procedures

pcs.pc_description: comply with safety and security policies and procedures
use appropriate safety gears like gowns, shoecover, headgear, masks, gloves and other relevant safety accessories as per regulatory guidelines throughout the process
report any identified breaches in safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
use pulleys/ forklift (if available) to transport the material/ spares/ heavy assembly and tools
comply with material handling, segregation, storage, and MSDS guidelines as per 5S system
segregate material and follow the 5S system at the storage area
record the details of completed safety drills and training
raise the alarm and report any hazards which is not competent to deal with, to the relevant person in line with organizational procedures and warn other people who may get affected
inform the concerned person immediately about every unsafe act/ incident
follow emergency protocol for any alarms and ensure the safety of subordinates in the area
follow emergency protocols efficiently

check the calibration status of testing equipment before the use
identify the testing parameters which need to be measured during the test procedure

modules.module_title: Perform inspection of medical devices and its accessories

pcs.pc_description: follow safety instructions recommended as per SOP during the inspection and testing process
perform the visual inspection test for fault diagnosis as per the SOP
calibrate, align and adjust the settings of medical device as per the SOP and organizational standards
ensure part clearances as specified in the SOP

modules.module_title: Test medical device and its components for faults in laboratory

pcs.pc_description: set the test apparatus as per the selected testing process and SOPs
connect the various data capturing meters and gauges to capture the stress levels and other data points
check the working of the test apparatus post-connecting the test component/ medical device to ensure error free testing activity

diagnose faults in the various sensors, power supply lines, electrical and electronic circuits and aggregates etc. in the medical device by following senior's instructions as well as user manual and risk management file

conduct various tests such as Emission tests, Immunity test, Electrostatic Discharge Test, Harmonic Current Emission Test, Surge Immunity Test, Voltage Flicker & Fluctuations test, etc. as per SOP under the supervision as per IEC 60601-1-2
record observations/ readings as per the parameters mentioned in the testing manual/work instructions
make minor modification in test setup/medical device /component cum accessories under testing to take reading under different scenarios as per the requirement
observe any deviations, noise or vibrations during the testing process and inform the test supervisor about the same

modules.module_title: Conduct testing of medical device under running condition

pcs.pc_description: Check the medical device before starting the testing on medical device as per the checklist and required collateral standards requirements
check working of all the safety features and system warning indicators showing system failures, etc. of medical device as per the testing parameters
maintain and update the records test results, data log etc. as per SOP
report and document the errors in the medical devices to the supervisor
clean and store the tools, equipment and process auxiliaries as per SOP after completion of work
dispose off scrap or waste material in accordance with the company policies and environmental regulations
